sections.heading: Learning Point 1
sections.content: Living Creatures: Exploring their Characteristics 10 Chapter Avadhi and Aayush go for a morning walk with their parents.
sections.source_evidence: Living Creatures: Exploring their Characteristics 10 Chapter Avadhi and Aayush go for a morning walk with their parents.

sections.heading: Learning Point 2
sections.content: Avadhi notices some shells and tries to pick them up.
sections.source_evidence: Avadhi notices some shells and tries to pick them up.

sections.heading: Learning Point 3
sections.content: Her mother advises her not to do so and explains that the shell could be home to a living snail and is actually a part of its body.
sections.source_evidence: Her mother advises her not to do so and explains that the shell could be home to a living snail and is actually a part of its body.

sections.heading: Learning Point 4
sections.content: Avadhi and Aayush wonder how the shell that is not even moving could have a living being inside!
sections.source_evidence: Avadhi and Aayush wonder how the shell that is not even moving could have a living being inside!

sections.heading: Learning Point 5
sections.content: Later that day in school, Avadhi and Aayush share this incident with their friends.

sections.heading: Learning Point 6
sections.content: They approach the teacher to understand how a shell which is not even moving could be a body part of a living snail.

sections.heading: Learning Point 7
sections.content: The teacher initiates a discussion in the class on living and non-living.

sections.heading: Learning Point 9
sections.content: Just look around in your classroom and you may find many examples—the pencil that you are holding, the book that you are reading or the pigeon near the window.   List them in Table 10.1 and identify each of them as living or non-living on the basis of your understanding in column II.   Write a reason for grouping them as living or non living in column III.
